sop_modules.name: Setup — Porch Floor Protection, Furniture Cover/Removal, Fixture Masking, Fascia/Wall/Siding Edge Protection, Equipment Setup
sop_modules.description: Full setup module for exterior porch ceiling repaint. Porch floor protection is CRITICAL — overhead work sends all drips and scraping debris straight down. Fascia/wall masking is MANDATORY in RP (adjacent surfaces are almost always already finished). Fixture masking covers ceiling fans, pendant lights, recessed cans. Equipment setup includes ladders and extension poles.

tasks.name: Porch Floor Protection
tasks.description: Deploy canvas drop cloths on porch floor below ceiling work zone. CRITICAL for overhead RP — catches drips, roller spatter, and scraping debris. Non-slip canvas for crew traffic.
tasks.notes: RP emphasis: catches scraping debris in addition to drips. Upgrade to full_cover for spray.
tasks.transfer_source: DIRECT from TSK_PRCH_FLOOR_PROTECT (re-keyed TSK_PRCH_ to TSK_PCRP_)

tasks.name: Porch Furniture Cover/Removal
tasks.description: Cover or remove porch furniture items. Rocking chairs, swings, tables. Removal preferred when possible. Full plastic coverage on non-removable items.
tasks.notes: RP: furniture is present and in use.

tasks.name: Porch Ceiling Fixture Masking
tasks.description: Mask ceiling-mounted fixtures overhead — ceiling fans (blade removal preferred), pendant lights, recessed cans. More complex than soffit fixtures.
tasks.notes: RP: all fixtures are installed and operational. Ceiling fans take 10-15 min with blade removal.

tasks.name: Fascia/Wall Junction Masking
tasks.description: Tape and masking film along fascia-ceiling and wall-ceiling junctions. In RP, fascia and wall are almost always already painted — masking is MANDATORY.
tasks.notes: RP: unconditional — adjacent surfaces almost always finished.

tasks.name: Adjacent Siding Masking (Spray Only)
tasks.description: Mask siding at porch wall junction during spray application. Film + tape 12-24 inches from ceiling edge. Not needed for brush_roll.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW task. Siding is almost always finished in RP context.

tasks.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Stage brushes, rollers, trays, extension poles for overhead work. Set up ladders/scaffold per access.
tasks.notes: Same as NC. ~25 min per section.

tasks.name: Spray Equipment Setup
tasks.description: Configure airless sprayer with 413-515 tip for overhead. Test spray pattern.
tasks.notes: Same as NC. ~45 min per section. No vent verification needed (porch ceiling has no vents).

sop_modules.name: EPA Lead-Safe RRP Containment (Pre-1978 Conditional)
sop_modules.description: Shared RRP module for pre-1978 homes. Lead screening, 6-mil poly containment extending 10 ft from structure, wet scraping methods, HEPA vacuum, containment teardown. Overhead scraping on porch ceiling is HIGH RISK — debris falls directly onto crew and porch floor.

tasks.name: Lead Paint Screening
tasks.description: XRF or swab test on representative porch ceiling areas. Required for pre-1978 homes.
tasks.notes: Shared RRP task. ~15 min per elevation.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Setup
tasks.description: Deploy 6-mil poly ground containment 10 ft from structure perimeter. WIDER than wall containment for overhead debris spread.
tasks.notes: Shared RRP task. ~45 min per elevation.

tasks.name: RRP Wet Scraping
tasks.description: Wet scraping method for lead paint removal overhead. Mist surface before scraping to suppress dust. Debris falls onto containment below.
tasks.notes: Shared RRP task. Overhead wet scraping is HIGH RISK — slower than vertical.

tasks.name: RRP HEPA Vacuum
tasks.description: HEPA vacuum all surfaces and containment after scraping.
tasks.notes: Shared RRP task. ~20 min per elevation.

tasks.name: RRP Containment Teardown
tasks.description: Remove containment poly. Bag and dispose per EPA RRP waste protocol.
tasks.notes: Shared RRP task. ~30 min per elevation.

sop_modules.name: Condition Assessment — Visual, Adhesion, Mildew, Moisture, Caulk
sop_modules.description: Multi-point condition assessment for porch ceiling repaint. Mildew/algae assessment is priority check (sheltered damp surface). Assessment determines substrate state, condition scale, and task activation.

tasks.name: Visual Condition Inspection
tasks.description: Scan all porch ceiling surfaces for chalking, cracking, peeling, adhesion failure, mildew/algae, moisture staining. Photograph defects. Assign substrate state and map to GOOD/FAIR/POOR.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. ~15-20 min per porch section.

tasks.name: Adhesion Test — ASTM D3359
tasks.description: Cross-hatch tape test on representative ceiling section to verify coating adhesion. Determines if existing paint is sound or failing.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. ~10 min per porch section. 2-3 test locations per section.

tasks.name: Mildew/Algae Assessment
tasks.description: Priority check for porch ceiling — sheltered damp surface is ideal for biological growth. Identify extent (spot vs widespread) and severity. Mildew appears as dark spots/patches. Must be treated before painting.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Porch ceiling priority — mildew is #1 degradation concern.

tasks.name: Moisture Probe — Wood Panels
tasks.description: Moisture meter on wood porch ceiling panels at joints and near roof penetrations. MC > 15% = stop work on that area until dry.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. ~5-10 min per porch section. Gate condition.

tasks.name: Caulk Condition Assessment
tasks.description: Inspect panel joint caulk and ceiling-to-fascia/wall junction caulk per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. Identify failed, cracked, or missing caulk runs.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. ~10 min per porch section.

sop_modules.name: Surface Preparation — Wash, Mildew Treatment, Chalk Remediation, Scrape/Feather, Degloss, Caulk Repair, Dust Cleanup
sop_modules.description: Condition-driven surface prep for porch ceiling repaint. Task activation depends on substrate state and condition scale. NEVER power wash. Low-pressure wash only.

tasks.name: Low-Pressure Wash Porch Ceiling
tasks.description: Garden hose + soft brush overhead with mildew-removal detergent. 500-800 PSI max, fan tip. Allow 24-48 hr dry time. NEVER power wash porch ceiling.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Same rate as NC wash. Overhead penalty baked into rate.

tasks.name: Mildew/Algae Biocide Treatment
tasks.description: Apply biocide/mildewcide solution to mildew-affected areas overhead. Sodium hypochlorite or commercial mildew remover. Allow to dwell, then rinse. MANDATORY — painting over mildew = adhesion failure.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Porch ceiling specific — highest mildew incidence. ~200 SF/hr overhead.

tasks.name: Chalk Residue Remediation
tasks.description: Remove loose chalk residue from chalking porch ceiling surface. Mechanical removal with stiff brush followed by detergent wash. Required before chalk-binding primer.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Overhead chalk remediation. ~150 SF/hr.

tasks.name: Scrape and Feather Failing/Peeling Paint
tasks.description: Scrape loose and failing paint overhead, then feather-sand all scraped edges to smooth transition. Slowest exterior prep task — gravity works against tool stroke. Carbide scraper recommended for overhead.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Overhead scraping is very slow. Condition scale drives intensity.

tasks.name: Degloss/Scuff Existing Sound Paint
tasks.description: Chemical deglosser or 150-grit mechanical scuff on sound existing paint overhead. Required for adhesion on sound painted surfaces.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Applied to sound paint areas. Overhead penalty baked in.

tasks.name: Caulk Replacement at Panel Joints
tasks.description: Remove failed caulk and replace at panel joints and ceiling-to-fascia/wall junctions overhead. Per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol. Apply after prime (COMPAT rule).
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Caulk after primer per COMPAT rule. Same rate as NC caulk.

tasks.name: Prep Dust Cleanup
tasks.description: Tack cloth dust removal overhead after all prep operations complete. Surface must be clean for primer/finish.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. ~400 SF/hr overhead.

sop_modules.name: State-Driven Primer Application
sop_modules.description: Primer selection driven by substrate state: chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, acrylic stain-block for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING on wood, alkali-resistant for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING on fiber cement. Skipped when GOOD condition with no exposed substrate.

tasks.name: State-Driven Primer — Brush/Roll Overhead
tasks.description: Apply state-driven primer by brush/roll overhead. Product selected by substrate state and material: chalk-binding for chalking, acrylic stain-block for failing/peeling wood, alkali-resistant for failing/peeling FC.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Same base rate as NC brush/roll prime. Spot or full prime based on condition.

tasks.name: State-Driven Primer — Spray Overhead
tasks.description: Apply state-driven primer by airless spray overhead. Always eligible on porch ceiling (no vent constraint).
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. Same base rate as NC spray prime. Spot or full prime based on condition.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat 1 — Cut-In + Brush/Roll or Spray + Groove Brush-Back
sop_modules.description: First finish coat application. Cut-in at fascia/wall/column junctions, then field application by brush/roll or spray. Groove brush-back on T&G/beadboard when spraying.

tasks.name: Cut-In at Junctions — Coat 1
tasks.description: Brush cut-in at fascia, wall, and column junctions overhead. Rate varies by QT.
tasks.notes: Same rates as NC cut-in. Overhead penalty baked in.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Overhead
tasks.description: Roller with extension pole for field, brush for grooves. Overhead penalty baked into rate.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. 120 SF/hr overhead.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Overhead
tasks.description: Airless spray finish overhead. Always eligible on porch ceiling.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. 250 SF/hr overhead.

tasks.name: Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 1
tasks.description: Brush into T&G/beadboard grooves while spray coat is wet. Two-person operation.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. 150 SF/hr overhead.

sop_modules.name: Interstage Inspection, Sand, Touch-Up
sop_modules.description: Between-coat inspection and maintenance. QT3: spot inspection and fix obvious defects. QT4: systematic inspection + full 220-grit intercoat sand. QT2: skipped (single coat).

tasks.name: Interstage Inspection
tasks.description: Visual inspection overhead between coats. Rate varies by QT.
tasks.notes: Same rates as NC.

tasks.name: Intercoat Light Sand — QT4 Only
tasks.description: 220-grit intercoat scuff overhead. QT4 only.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. 175 SF/hr overhead.

tasks.name: Interstage Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up overhead for defects found during inspection.
tasks.notes: Same rates as NC.

tasks.name: Intercoat Dust Removal — QT4 Only
tasks.description: Tack cloth after intercoat sanding. QT4 only.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. 400 SF/hr.

sop_modules.name: Finish Coat 2 (QT3/QT4 Only)
sop_modules.description: Second finish coat. QT3 and QT4 only (QT2 is single coat). Same method constraints as coat 1.

tasks.name: Cut-In at Junctions — Coat 2
tasks.description: Second coat cut-in overhead at fascia, wall, column junctions.
tasks.notes: Same rates as NC coat 2 cut-in.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Overhead
tasks.description: Second coat brush/roll. Final appearance coat.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC coat 2. 120 SF/hr.

tasks.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Overhead
tasks.description: Second coat spray. Final appearance coat.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC coat 2. 250 SF/hr.

tasks.name: Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 2
tasks.description: Final coat groove brush-back. All grooves must be fully coated.
tasks.notes: Same rate as NC. 150 SF/hr. RP emphasis: all grooves fully coated on final coat.

sop_modules.name: Final Inspection, Touch-Up, Protection Teardown, Equipment Clean, Site Cleanup, Customer Walkthrough
sop_modules.description: Final inspection from ground level, touch-up defects, remove all protection materials, clean equipment, restore porch, customer walkthrough with maintenance recommendations.

tasks.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
tasks.description: Ground-level and ladder inspection of completed porch ceiling. RP includes condition verification — confirm all prep issues resolved.
tasks.notes: RP includes condition verification. Same QT rates as NC.

tasks.name: Final Touch-Up
tasks.description: Brush touch-up overhead for defects found during final inspection. RP emphasis on blend quality where repairs were made.
tasks.notes: RP emphasis on blending. Same QT rates as NC.

tasks.name: Protection Material Removal
tasks.description: Remove all protection: floor drop cloths, furniture covers, fixture masks, fascia/wall/siding masking tape and film. Restore furniture to original positions. RP has more protection to remove than NC.
tasks.notes: RP has more protection to teardown. ~15% longer than NC.

tasks.name: Clean Equipment
tasks.description: Clean rollers, brushes, extension poles. Flush sprayer if used.
tasks.notes: Same as NC. ~30 min.

tasks.name: Site Debris Cleanup
tasks.description: Collect all debris including scraping waste. Final porch walkthrough. RP generates more debris than NC.
tasks.notes: RP generates more debris. ~25 min (vs 20 NC).
tasks.transfer_source: DIRECT from TSK_PRCH_SITE_CLEANUP (re-keyed, RP time adjustment)

tasks.name: Customer Walkthrough
tasks.description: Walk completed porch ceiling with customer. Point out work performed. Provide maintenance recommendations: mildew-resistant formulation, annual mildew check, caulk inspection.
tasks.notes: RP-NEW. ~15 min. Maintenance recommendations extend repaint cycle.

task_count_summary.note: Total includes 5 shared RRP tasks. Excludes 2 NC-only interstage dust tasks implicitly included in QT4 interstage module.
